title: When Someone Is Lying Straight to Your Face
description: Doug walks into the living room. Green is on the couch eating chocolate cake, Doug's cake box hidden behind his hip. Doug: "Did you eat my cake?" Green: "What? No." Doug looks at the cake on the fork; Green slowly lowers it: "I haven't even seen your cake." Doug looks at the box, back at Green's frosting-smeared mouth. Green: "Why are you looking at me like that?" Silence, push in, a piece of cake falls from his mouth onto his shirt. Both look down. Green, dead serious: "...That's not mine." Doug's long deadpan stare. Cut to black.
